title: Is Northwind Robotics about to be bought?
text:
There is chatter in Rotterdam that Northwind Robotics has held early talks with Larchmont Industrial about a possible sale. Two people who say they are close to the matter told this blog that the conversations are at an early stage and may come to nothing. Neither company replied to requests for comment.

Larchmont has been buying warehouse automation firms for two years, so the idea is not far-fetched. But Northwind has just raised a Series B, which usually means the founders want to keep building.
